title: NeuralDRAM: DRAM Architecture for Neural Network Acceleration
problem: Neural network operations incur excessive data movement between DRAM and processing units, creating memory bandwidth bottlenecks that limit performance and energy efficiency.
motivation: Reducing data movement overhead through in-memory computation is critical for improving energy efficiency and performance in neural network accelerators.
method: NeuralDRAM integrates matrix multiplication capabilities directly into the DRAM architecture, enabling computation within memory cells without moving data to separate processing units. This specialized design reduces off-chip data movement and memory bandwidth requirements for neural network workloads.
key_novelty: Direct support for matrix multiplication operations within DRAM architecture itself to eliminate data movement overhead.
contributions: Specialized DRAM architecture optimized for neural network operations
2.5x energy efficiency improvement over conventional approaches
